## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] A test covers the change (security-relevant changes: a test that fails without it)
- [ ] `byteflow/CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `[Unreleased]` if users will notice
- [ ] README edits were made in `README.md` and synced with `python scripts/sync_readme.py`
